part1.title: Introduction and Interview
part1.instructions: I'd like to ask you about your hobbies and free time activities.
questions: What do you like to do in your free time?
Do you have any hobbies?
How often do you do your hobby?
Do you prefer indoor or outdoor activities?
Did you have the same hobbies when you were a child?

part2.title: Individual Long Turn
part2.duration: 3-4 minutes total (1 min prep + 2 min speaking)

cueCard.title: Describe a hobby or activity you really enjoy
points: And explain why you enjoy it so much
cueCard.notes: You will have 1 minute to prepare and 1-2 minutes to speak.

part3.title: Two-way Discussion
part3.instructions: Now let's discuss hobbies and leisure activities in general.
questions: Why do you think people need hobbies?
Are there any hobbies that are popular in your country?
Do you think expensive hobbies are better than cheap ones?
How have people's leisure activities changed over time?
Should children be encouraged to have hobbies?

modelAnswer.part2: I'd like to talk about reading, which is a hobby I really enjoy. I started reading books when I was about ten years old. My teacher at school encouraged us to read more, and I discovered that I really liked stories about adventure and friendship. Now I try to read for at least thirty minutes every day, usually before I go to bed. On weekends, I sometimes spend two or three hours reading because I have more free time. I enjoy reading so much because it helps me relax after a busy day. When I read, I can forget about my problems and enter into different worlds and meet interesting characters. Reading also helps me learn new words and improve my language skills. I like many different types of books, but I especially enjoy mystery novels and stories about travel. Reading is not expensive, and I can do it anywhere - at home, in the park, or even on the bus.

modelAnswer.part2: I would really like to visit Japan one day. Japan is a beautiful country in Asia, famous for its ancient temples, modern cities, and delicious food. I've seen many pictures of Japan in books and on the internet, and it looks absolutely amazing. The cities are very clean and modern, with tall buildings and bright lights. But there are also peaceful gardens and traditional temples where you can experience the old culture. If I went to Japan, I would want to visit Tokyo, which is the capital city. I would like to see the famous cherry blossoms in spring, try authentic Japanese food like sushi and ramen, and visit some of the historic temples. I would also love to experience the bullet train, which travels very fast between cities. I want to visit Japan because I'm interested in Japanese culture, especially their art, music, and way of life. I think visiting Japan would be a wonderful adventure and I would learn so much about a different way of living. It would also be a great opportunity to practice speaking English with people from another country.

modelAnswer.part2: I really enjoy playing football, which is my favorite sport. I've been playing football since I was a child, and I still play it regularly now. I usually play football twice a week with my friends at a local sports center. We have a small team of about ten people, and we play matches every weekend. Sometimes we also watch professional football matches on television, especially when our favorite teams are playing. I love football because it's exciting and requires both physical fitness and mental strategy. When I play, I feel energetic and happy. It's also a great way to spend time with friends and make new ones. Football helps me stay healthy and fit, and it's a good way to relieve stress after a long day at work or school. What makes football special to me is the teamwork involved. You can't win a match alone - you need to work together with your teammates. This has taught me important lessons about cooperation and communication that I use in other parts of my life too.

modelAnswer.part2: Last summer, I went to a music festival in the city center with my best friend. It was a free outdoor event that lasted all day, from morning until late evening. There were several stages with different types of music, including pop, rock, and traditional music. We arrived early in the afternoon and stayed until the end. The weather was perfect - sunny and warm - and there were hundreds of people enjoying the music. We walked around between the stages, listening to different bands and singers. My favorite performance was by a local band that played traditional music with modern instruments. The crowd was very enthusiastic and many people were dancing. We also tried some delicious food from the food stalls and met some interesting people. I really enjoyed this event because it was a great way to discover new music and spend time with my friend. The atmosphere was amazing - everyone was happy and having a good time. It was also free, which made it accessible to everyone. I would definitely go to another music festival like this in the future.

modelAnswer.part2: I'd like to talk about a book I read recently called 'The Little Prince'. It's a famous book written by a French author, and I read it in English translation. The story is about a young prince who travels from planet to planet, meeting different characters and learning about life. The book is quite short but very meaningful. It talks about friendship, love, and what's really important in life. What I enjoyed most about this book is how it makes you think about simple things in a deeper way. The characters are interesting and the story is both sad and beautiful. The book has beautiful illustrations that help you understand the story better. I found it very moving, especially the parts about friendship and saying goodbye. I would definitely recommend this book to others because it's not just a children's story - adults can enjoy it too. It teaches important lessons about life in a simple and beautiful way. The language is also not too difficult, which makes it perfect for English learners like me.

modelAnswer.part2: I'd like to tell you about my best friend, whose name is Sarah. We've been friends for about five years now. We met in high school when we were both new students, and we sat next to each other in our English class. At first, we were both shy, but we started talking and discovered we had many things in common. Sarah is a very kind and funny person. She always makes me laugh with her jokes and stories. She's also very supportive - whenever I have a problem, she listens and gives me good advice. We both love reading books and watching movies, so we often do these activities together. On weekends, we usually go to a café or visit the park. Sometimes we study together, which makes studying more fun. What I like most about Sarah is that she's honest and trustworthy. I know I can always count on her, and she never judges me. She's also very creative and has great ideas for things we can do together. Sarah is important to me because she's not just a friend - she's like family. She understands me better than anyone else, and I feel comfortable being myself around her. Having a friend like Sarah makes my life happier and more meaningful.
